source: Contextual representation models changed the unit of representation. ELMo generated word representations as functions of the entire input sentence using bidirectional language-model states. BERT then learned deep bidirectional Transformer representations by conditioning each token on both left and right context during pretraining. [6,7]
zh: 上下文表示模型改变了表示单位。 ELMo 使用双向语言模型状态生成单词表示作为整个输入句子的函数。然后，BERT 在预训练期间通过在左右上下文中调节每个标记来学习深度双向 Transformer 表示。 [6,7]
